sources.title: Legislative Herald of Georgia (Matsne), Organic Law of Georgia – Labour Code of Georgia, consolidated version (final), English, Article 30 − Holidays
sources.said: Article 30 − Holidays 1. Holidays shall be: a) January 1 and 2 – New Year holidays; b) January 7 – Christmas Day ...; c) January 19 – Epiphany ...; d) March 3 – Mother's Day; e) March 8 – International Women's Day; f) April 9 – the day of adopting the Act of Restoring Independence of Georgia ...; g) Easter holidays – Good Friday, Holy Saturday, Easter Sunday ..., Easter Monday – All Souls' Day (movable feast); h) May 9 – Victory Day over Fascism; i) May 12 – Day of Georgia as the abode of the Holy Mother ...; i1) May 17 – Family Purity and Respect for Parents Day; j) May 26 – Independence Day of Georgia; k) August 28 – ... 'Mariamoba'; l) October 14 – 'Mtskhetoba' ...; m) November 23 – St. George's Day. ... 3. In addition to the holidays provided for by this Law, other days off may be determined by an ordinance of the Government of Georgia.

sources.title: Relocation.ge, Public Holidays in Georgia (2026) (last reviewed 31 August 2026): the Labour Code of Georgia, art. 30
sources.said: Georgia has 14 fixed public holidays plus a four-day Easter block, set by Article 30 of the Labour Code — 18 days in a typical year. … 1–2 January New Year holidays 7 January Christmas Day — Birth of Our Lord Jesus Christ 19 January Epiphany — Baptism of Our Lord Jesus Christ 3 March Mother’s Day 8 March International Women’s Day 9 April Day of the Act of Restoring Independence of Georgia; day of national unity, national consent, and commemoration of those who died for the national integrity of Georgia 9 May Victory Day over Fascism 12 May Day of Georgia as the abode of the Holy Mother; Commemoration Day of St Andrew the Apostle, Founder of the Apostolic Church of Georgia; Day of Hope 17 May Family Purity and Respect for Parents Day 26 May Independence Day of Georgia 28 August Assumption of the Virgin Mary — Mariamoba 14 October Mtskhetoba — Svetitskhovloba, Robe of Jesus 23 November St George’s Day — Giorgoba … Article 30(1)(g) treats Easter as a single block of four consecutive days : Good Friday, Holy Saturday, Easter Sunday (Resurrection of Our Lord Jesus Christ) and Easter Monday (All Souls’ Day). … Under Article 30(3) , the Government may declare further days off by ordinance
